sources.snippet: GAIA Agent: Agents Course Unit 4 A smolagents CodeAgent (Gemini) that answers the 20 GAIA level-1 questions of the final assignment. The code is a Python package in src/gaia_agent/ with one folder per service. This Space only holds the code; the agent is run locally and answers are submitted through the course API.
